scope: RF-only shared dynamic fit with free constant differential station code bias and conditional independent-arc weights. Exposed historical qualifications; mostly temporal holdouts and one beyond-all-training endpoint per estimator. Force, atmosphere, clock, bias stability and joint physical covariance unqualified.
training_propagation: VMF3 recomputed at the current shared trial geometry, with state/clock/ground derivatives

superseded_independence_claim.reason: Historical RF-fitted propagation entered preprocessing. No known target orbit was used, but prior_target_state_used=False understated that dependence. Old bytes/results remain historical diagnostics, not evidence for a fit independent of prior target geometry.

branch_failures.reason: finite exterior-Earth state and gravity coefficient required

cohort.rule: even chronological indices; inherited accepted status; no replacement
